name: diagram
title: Diagram
description: Nodes, edges, labels and regions on a Canvas, as plain data. Lines keep their thickness at any zoom, text hides when it's too small to read, and only what's near the view is drawn. With editable: selecting, dragging, deleting and undo as one gesture, named ports, and connecting with validation. Every node and edge can be reached by keyboard, and says what it connects to.
